en.title: Backend Developer
en.stack: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Jest, AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, API Gateway, Docker, Microservices, REST APIs

items: Built serverless, event-driven flows with AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS and Step Functions.
Developed modular Node.js services with NestJS and REST APIs for service integrations, with attention to performance and security.
Worked on parallelism and concurrency in services that run many tasks at once.
Wrote unit and end-to-end test suites with Jest, including for GraphQL APIs.
Worked in a microservices architecture, with API Gateway routing requests between services, and containerized services with Docker.

pt.title: Desenvolvedor Backend
pt.stack: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Jest, AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, API Gateway, Docker, Microservices, REST APIs

items: Construí fluxos serverless e orientados a eventos com AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS e Step Functions.
Desenvolvi serviços Node.js modulares com NestJS e APIs REST para integrações entre serviços, com atenção a desempenho e segurança.
Trabalhei com paralelismo e concorrência em serviços que executam muitas tarefas ao mesmo tempo.
Escrevi suítes de testes unitários e de ponta a ponta com Jest, inclusive para APIs GraphQL.
Atuei numa arquitetura de microsserviços, com o API Gateway roteando as requisições entre serviços, e conteinerizei serviços com Docker.
